report: Checked all four candidate lemmas; none is a split. אֱלֹהִים takes 'God', 'O God' (vocative O, rule 36), 'are gods' (predicate copula, rule 20) and 'the gods' (supplied determiner, rule 15) as the ASV writes each. שָׁפַט differs only in the subject pronouns and auxiliaries rule 17 attaches. בְּ is fused with קֶרֶב as 'among' in v1 (rule 30), takes 'in' in v5, and is unrepresented in v8 where 'inherit all the nations' promotes its object (rule 40). אֶרֶץ takes 'of the earth' as a rectum in v5 and bare 'earth' beside a written article in v8.

Cross-verse consistency of the anarthrous substantival adjectives (דַל, רְשָׁעִים, עָנִי, אֶבְיוֹן, רָשׁ) is intact: the first member of each coordinated pair takes the phrase's single supplied 'the' under rule 46 and the second is left bare in v3 and v4 alike; רְשָׁעִים as rectum takes 'of the wicked' in v2 and v4 alike.

BSB disagreements are all convention: two paragogic he tokens (Sh) in v8 and the paragogic nun in v7 are unrepresented under rule 32, and the בְּ of v8 is silenced by the ASV's object promotion under rule 40. None is an error.
The two repeated notes flagged by the validator (construct noun takes supplied 'the', rule 29; substantival adjective takes supplied 'the', rule 46) restate contract rules and need no convention.

v2's עַד־מָתַי → 'How long' is noncompositional on rule 6's first-token fallback with the competing split named in the note; v4's 'them' is added under rule 44's supplied-object clause; v3's 'Do justice to' keeps the valency 'to' with the verb under rule 44. Each is defensible as returned.
